<item>The secret of getting ahead is getting started.</item>
        <item>Today is a new beginning. Make the most of it.</item>
        <item>Your future is created by what you do today.</item>
        <item>Rise up, start fresh, see the bright opportunity in each new day.</item>
        <item>Every morning brings new potential.</item>
        <item>Do something today that your future self will thank you for.</item>
        <item>The only way to do great work is to love what you do.</item>
        <item>Believe you can and you are halfway there.</item>
        <item>Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.</item>
        <item>The best time for new beginnings is now.</item>
        <item>You are never too old to set another goal or to dream a new dream.</item>
        <item>What you do today can improve all your tomorrows.</item>
        <item>Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.</item>
        <item>It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.</item>
        <item>Act as if what you do makes a difference. It does.</item>
